sentences: Today, we are talking about deserts. Do you have any questions about deserts?
What's the climate like in deserts?
It is usually dry, because there is little rain.
Is it hot in deserts?
Not always. There are cold deserts. It is hot in summer but very cold in winter.

sentences: Hello, Lulu. Can you go swimming with me?
I'm sorry, I can't. I'm busy now.
What are you doing?
I'm buying some flowers for Tomb-sweeping Day.
Tomb-sweeping Day? Is it a festival?
Yes, it is an important festival in China. Every year, in April, we visit the tombs of our late family members.

Wow, there are so many stars! And some of them shine brighter than others.
Look at the brightest ones. Are they the Big Dipper and the North Star?
Yes, they are. The Big Dipper looks like a spoon. Follow the two stars on the right, and you can find the North Star.
Many stars are far, far away. Let me see more through the telescope.

No, it's a silk one.

sentences: Look at this.
A model rocket! Who made it?
It was made by me.
Wow! What's it made of?
It's made of metal. Do you know what a rocket is used for?
Sure. It's used for sending satellites or spaceships into space.
You're right. I've learned a lot about spaceships from Mr. Brown and then I made this model rocket. I wish I could go into space some day.
I hope your dream will come true.
